locks_to_keep: The sedative is never named or measured. 'sedative' (s1e01 l03), 'dose', 'sachet', 'whole' and 'half' are the only words used. No quantity, no drug name.
'Rekha' and 'Tulsi' are never spoken in branch B. 'Tulsi' is spoken once only, in s1a03 b10 (l26). 'Pooja' may be spoken once, in s1a03 b3, or not at all.

The scar's origin (a tawa in her uncle's kitchen, at fourteen) is spoken only by Mausi, in s1b03 b4. The shared episodes may say what the photograph shows (a burn like a half moon), never where it came from or whose it is.
No line before s1a03 b3 (A) or s1b03 b4 (B) says, or lets Aditya learn, that the hand is Kiran's. Kiran must not confess early, including in s1a01 l05.
Mohit's death is stated as fact once (s1e01 l25) and only referred to after that: never pictured, re-enacted or described further.

The groom first hears 'Kiran' from Billu: s1a01 b6 (A) or s1b01 b4 (B). The bridge line in s1e01 b5 is in the lane, out of his hearing. On the 2 am speaker call (s1e02 b10, b13) Mausi says only 'beta', never the name.
Aditya does not know an alarm phrase exists until s1a01 b3 or s1b01 b1. Nothing Kiran says in s1e02 may give him the phrase. 'If all's well' is allowed; a second phrase is not.
The choice lines are spoken whole, as the first line of each branch: s1a01 l01 and s1b01 l01. No part of either is begun in s1e02.
Locked lines (bible story_locks.locked_lines): s1e01 l01, l25, l26; s1e02 l29; s1a01 l01, l13; s1b01 l01, l03, l19. Their wording does not change. Only their set-up may.
Kept apart in the two finales: 'You taught me this' only in s1a03 b5; 'The boy turned out weak' only in s1b01 b10; Mausi reaches for the wrist only in s1b03 b4.
The chooda dialogue ban: no line says how tightly a chooda fits, how hard it is to take off, or how long a bride must wear it.
s1b02 b4: nothing in script or subtitle gives away what Kiran whispers or what is in the glass before s1b02 b9.
Mausi is never seen in s1e01 or s1e02. The boys never speak and never show a face.
Glimpse must_not_reveal lists: s1ga (s1a01) and s1gb (s1b01), in the bible's glimpses block.
D-004 direction 5's forms of address apply to Series 2 only. Nothing in Series 1 depends on them.
